title: A dispatched worker's session leaves work rows land can attribute, so cost reads every item of a sprint
goal: Every worker that backlog.py dispatch starts leaves a branch, agent-start or agent-stop row naming its item in the clone's query log spool, and land names why when none exists. Retrospective of SP-htl7jkrm: ST-ksgrpumr's land warned 'landed with no work rows (missing): no worker session of it left a branch, agent-start or agent-stop row', while its siblings dispatched the same way showed late rows; ST-65r3cwix landed with its work sidecar undelivered; cost --rework SP-htl7jkrm read 0 runs at review time.
notes: Recurred in SP-tcis5f23 (2026-10-13): cost --rework SP-tcis5f23 at the close read 0 runs and only the orchestrator's open session; no worker's Sonnet usage was attributed, and ops showed no agent.run rows. Worker spend from their result.json: research 2.20 USD, the seven bugs 0.33-0.66 USD each, reviewer 1.64 USD.
